name: Minimp3

source.verification: GitHub HTTPS commit archive of the author's repository (head of master = afb604c06bc8beb145fecd42c0ceb5bda8795144), downloaded on 2026-11-22 and its SHA-256 recorded. Upstream publishes no releases or signatures, so it is pinned by the commit and the archive hash. Imported files are minimp3.h, minimp3_ex.h and LICENSE (tests, vectors, player and tools are not imported).

licenses.upstreamExpression: CC0 1.0 Universal dedication in LICENSE and in the header comments

notes: MP3 source decoder for the audio importer (Docs/Design/AudioSystem.ko.md sections 3.10.1 and 3.26). Developer only: AudioTools links it, runtime targets do not.

Minimp3Glue.c compiles the header-only implementation once (MINIMP3_IMPLEMENTATION, float output, no stdio, Layer III only: MINIMP3_ONLY_MP3 leaves out the Layer I and II decoder, which AudioTools rejects anyway) and exposes the static tag helpers of minimp3_ex.h (ID3 skip, Xing/LAME tag) under Rocks names. The tag reader gets a zero-padded copy of the frame because mp3dec_check_vbrtag reads the tag fields before it checks the frame size. AudioTools decodes frame by frame with mp3dec_decode_frame and never calls the minimp3_ex load or ex functions, which allocate with malloc and realloc.
SIMD is selected at compile time (SSE2 on x86-64, NEON on ARM64) with no runtime CPU dispatch, so decoded samples are fixed per architecture (decision of section 3.10.1 on determinism).
